script_text: Stop everything, Aquarius — Uranus, your ruling planet, just formed a powerful trine to the Moon, and it's shaking up your entire fifth house of romance and creativity. This air sign is about to feel a magnetic surge of confidence that pulls people toward you like gravity. In love, single Aquarians, someone unexpected will catch your eye through a creative or social space today, and a deep conversation sparks instantly. Paired Aquarians, your partner needs extra emotional honesty right now, so don't deflect with logic. For career and money, Jupiter sextile your second house of income means a financial opportunity arrives disguised as a casual conversation. Watch for it. The warning? Don't overcommit to someone else's chaos today — protect your energy fiercely. The unexpected gift is a creative breakthrough you didn't see coming. Follow for tomorrow's reading, Aquarius, because the stars aren't done with you.
